input.ticket: Since 09:17 UTC, 38% of EU card checkouts fail with PSP timeout. Refund and wallet payments are unaffected. Latest deploy changed payment retry policy.
Enterprise SSO users cannot log in after MFA challenge. Error rate is 31% across US tenants. No deploy is mentioned.
Tracking webhook updates for one courier in Tokyo are delayed by 20 minutes. Queue depth is dropping after a carrier retry backlog cleared.
Video uploads are stuck in moderation processing for creators in Brazil. The issue started right after a media pipeline deployment.
All public API requests return 503 after the primary database cluster failed over. The incident affects every region.
A finance admin asks for a copy of last month's invoice and confirms there is no failed charge or outage.
